text_block_list.text:
At last, <chrname>'s entry into the Twinkle Star 
Climax has been decided!

Sharing in the joy with Reporter Otonashi, 
I listened as she spoke of her 
extraordinary passion for making the 
Twinkle Star Climax a reality.

I want them to witness the exact moment a 
truly strong Umamusume proves her 
strength—

I want to prove that <chrname> is the strongest. 
That desire burned even stronger within 
me.
